challenge_context: Fresh correction or erratum review informed by prior tag challenges. Current hashes, targets, metamorphics and tag facts checked independently; no other reviewer file read.
scope: Tags are checked against final constructed tasks, not original template intent. Semantic target values continue to be checked independently.

Positive equal-route claims have distinct feasible simple-route witnesses. New no-equal-route claims exhaust complete goal-ending walks, including departures from and revisits to the goal, bounded by positive integer fuel costs.
The ordinal predicate tags are opaque producer strata and are not assigned an invented meaning.
The immutable pilot release is read only; errata live in separate review/audit files.
Correction batches preserve source families and are not new independent mechanism samples.
